headline: On last trading day, Sensex plunged 1,484 points; markets closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Market is closed for trading today in observance of Guru Nanak Jayanti
Heavy selling pressure in banking and metal stocks during the previous session
Weak global market cues weighed on investor sentiment
Profit booking following a significant surge in the Sensex throughout November
whatHappening: The Sensex plummeted 1,484 points while the Nifty 50 fell below the 25,350 mark
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) continued their buying streak for the 16th consecutive session
Investors' total wealth has increased by ₹34.61 trillion during the month of November
Audi India announced a price hike of up to 2% across its vehicle range from January
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti after the Sensex plunged 1,484 points in the last session.
The market decline was led by banking and metal stocks, though FIIs extended their buying streak to 16 sessions.
Despite the recent drop, investor wealth has grown by ₹34.61 trillion in November, with markets reopening on Wednesday.
